description: Browse Printful products and stores, estimate shipping and costs, and create, update or cancel unconfirmed draft orders.

printful_new_or_updated_order_trigger.description: Runs for each order added or changed in Printful. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name

printful_new_or_updated_store_product_tr.description: Runs for each store product added or changed in Printful. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on start it only when they change. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name

printful_new_order_trigger.description: Runs for each new order in Printful. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name

printful_new_store_product_trigger.description: Runs for each new store product in Printful. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields id, name
